description: Declarative query over a JSON event log (array, NDJSON or a URL to either, up to 500,000 events) without writing a parser: filter on dotted field paths (eq, ne, gt, gte, lt, lte, contains, regex, in, exists, missing), sort by a field, compute the delta and percent change between successive events (optionally per group_by key, e.g. per agent) and keep only events whose delta crosses a threshold, collapse runs shorter than N consecutive events, pick output fields, and get group counts, delta stats and a manifest of every field the query assumed. Built for agent traces, latency logs and state-transition dumps. Costs $0.004 USDC per call (x402).

events.description: JSON array, NDJSON string, or URL
